Model extraction 
The publication and canonical model are preserved. The retained audit matched 97 
core parameters, 232 diet cells and 775 roundtrip values; prior diet normalization, 
GS defaults and residual BA completion remain documented. 
Derived runtime correction: source seabird self-diet 0.0002 (Table S3!W24), 
normalized to 0.000200080032, is set to zero. All remaining seabird prey, including 
detritus, are multiplied by 1.000200120072; diet sum is 1. Every other diet and all 
groups are retained. This is an authorized scenario, not a claim that the published 
cell is a typographical error. 
Predation is recomputed from unchanged consumption. Only 13 affected BA entries 
with matching loader-derived provenance are recomputed from P − M0 − catch − 
predation − net migration. Seabird BA changes from −0.0000135334 to 
0.0001200000; detritus BA from 1658.41530027 to 1658.41527234 t km⁻² year⁻¹. All 
other BA and biological parameters are preserved. Detritus inflow and fate routing 
are unchanged.

Temporal fit 
Static 1991–1995 ecosystem coefficients are applied across catch years 1950–2019. 
The 2019 reference is 24–28 years later. Fixed biomass/catch composition proxies do 
not reconstruct annual ecosystem change; publication 2025 does not make the 
historical model contemporary.
